name: Kavaron
description: Kavaron is the Kav homeworld, Sothera's richest world, torn in two into the habitable Kavaron Before and the broken Kavaron That Is.

description_citations.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Edge of Eternities
description_citations.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Edge of Eternities" by Miguel Lopez, Jay Annelli, Laurel Pratt, Amanda LaFranco. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2025.
"Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

summary.text: Kavaron is the Kav homeworld, Sothera's richest world, torn in two into the habitable Kavaron Before and the broken Kavaron That Is.

citations.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Edge of Eternities
citations.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Edge of Eternities" by Miguel Lopez, Jay Annelli, Laurel Pratt, Amanda LaFranco. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2025.
"Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

bio.text: After centuries of mining destabilized their world, the Kav began an exodus from Kavaron.

citations.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Edge of Eternities
citations.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Edge of Eternities" by Miguel Lopez, Jay Annelli, Laurel Pratt, Amanda LaFranco. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2025.

bio.text: Tan and the crew headed for Kavaron, and the Seriema flew through the Mordraine Ring toward Kavaron That Is to find a stasis cask.

citations.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 2" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jun 2025.
"Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

bio.text: Taro-duend sits on Kavaron That Is.

citations.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 6" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jun 2025.

bio.text: It is the world where six thousand died in an atrocity, and Tannuk was dishonorably discharged from the KMN for redirecting a falling chunk of its debris belt.

citations.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

citations.work: The Legends of Edge of Eternities
citations.text: "The Legends of Edge of Eternities" by Miguel Lopez, Amanda LaFranco, Laurel Pratt, Jay Annelli. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2025.

status.text: Kavaron remains a ruined, strip-mined world split in two, with Thendar deposited back on Kavaron That Is in the latest event.

citations.work: The Legends of Edge of Eternities
citations.text: "The Legends of Edge of Eternities" by Miguel Lopez, Amanda LaFranco, Laurel Pratt, Jay Annelli. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2025.

citations.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Edge of Eternities
citations.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Edge of Eternities" by Miguel Lopez, Jay Annelli, Laurel Pratt, Amanda LaFranco. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Pursued by Vondam, Alpharael is shot down in the debris field of Kavaron and rescued by Sami and Tannuk.
timeline.quote: Alpharael was shot down and crashed in the debris field of Kavaron

citation.text: "Alpharael", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Haliya tries to force Alpharael to alter the past; Vondam slaughters the Kav citizens, convincing Haliya the Summists were wrong, and the crew escapes.
timeline.quote: Vondam refused to hurt Haliya and opened fire on the Kav citizens instead, slaughtering them all.

citation.text: "Alpharael", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vondam and Haliya track Alpharael to Kavaron; after Haliya fails he orders the massacre of Taro-duend and surrenders.
timeline.quote: he enacted protocol seven, ordering the massacre of all 6,000 inhabitants of Taro-duend

citation.text: "Vondam", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Kav begin an exodus from Kavaron after centuries of mining that destabilized their world.
timeline.quote: Decades have passed since Exodus Day, when the first Kav shuttle lifted the first flight of refugees off Kavaron's unstable surface.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Edge of Eternities
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Edge of Eternities" by Miguel Lopez, Jay Annelli, Laurel Pratt, Amanda LaFranco. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Tan notes moxite's value has been sliding everywhere in Sothera though the mine never opened, and they head for Kavaron.
timeline.quote: Like someone opened a new moxite mine here.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 2" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: The Seriema flies through the Mordraine Ring toward Kavaron That Is to find a stasis cask for their prize.
timeline.quote: The Seriema plunges stern first through the Mordraine Ring, toward Kavaron That Is and a stasis cask to hold their prize.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: The Seriema and the Hopelight lose sight of each other as the Seriema reenters Kavaron's atmosphere.
timeline.quote: They lose track of the Hopelight behind them as they make reentry.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Tan detects a Kavaron Memorial Navy team in the area, probably heading for the same cache.
timeline.quote: No. There's someone else down there.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: The Hopelight fires its fusion engine in the atmosphere, blowtorches Tan's cache site and crashes into the rock.
timeline.quote: The Hopelight descends on its plume of disaster, blowtorches the cache site with its suicidal engine burn, and splatters into the rock.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami lands the Seriema on a basalt plain, and they set out for the cache.
timeline.quote: Sami sets the Seriema down on a plain of flood basalt

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami decides to investigate the crashed Hopelight despite Tan's fear of the KMN.
timeline.quote: "We should take a look," Sami settles on.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami promises Tan they will not let the Kav hurt him.
timeline.quote: I won't let them hurt you. I promise.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami learns the wounded Hopelight pilot is a Monoist who has stolen the Free Company's fighter.
timeline.quote: That's a Monoist name. In a Sunstar Free Company fighter.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami introduces themself to Alpharael and promises to get him out alive.
timeline.quote: I'm Captain Sami, and my friend is Tannuk.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Armed Kav of the Memorial Navy surround the crash site.
timeline.quote: The crater rim is lined with armed Kav.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: The subedar accuses Tannuk of violating his exile.
timeline.quote: you have violated the terms of your exile.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: A narrator reveals that Sami's rescue attempt was a deliberate drastic intervention against Pinnacle.
timeline.quote: Pinnacle must be disrupted.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami removes their helmet and invents a cover story as an agent of the Monastery of the True Faith.
timeline.quote: We serve the Monastery of the True Faith at Susur Secundi, which you call Anuki.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Alpharael plays along, claiming the Free Company plans to destroy Sothera.
timeline.quote: The Sunstar Free Company plans to destroy Sothera

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: The subedar offers to escort them to Taro-duend if they prove they are Monoists.
timeline.quote: Prove you're with the Monoists, and we will escort you to the strike town at Taro-duend.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami gambles that the Metalman's artifact on the Seriema can pass for a damaged singularity bead.
timeline.quote: "The proof is in the cache," Sami says, gambling wildly.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: The subedar laughs and agrees to fetch a stasis cask and take them all to Taro-duend.
timeline.quote: We'll get you a stasis cask for your singularity and take you all to Taro-duend.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: The subedar makes Tannuk call an old coin flip; the coin lands point facing her.
timeline.quote: More chance than you gave your victims, Tannuk.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: The Kav retrieve the cask from the cache and Alpharael from the Hopelight, putting him in the cask.
timeline.quote: The Kav pull the stasis cask out of Tan's old cache and Alpharael out of the downed Hopelight.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: The Kav load the stasis cask into the Seriema's cargo bay next to the hotcell holding the Metalman's artifact.
timeline.quote: The Kav haul the stasis cask up into the cargo bay and park it next to the hotcell containing the weird rock from Sigma.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: A Kav opens the hotcell and sees the artifact, which looks like a spitball.
timeline.quote: The Metalman's artifact lies there, in the dark, in a wasp's nest of congealed shear starch.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Alpharael enters the hotcell to move the supposed bead.
timeline.quote: "I want to live," Alpharael says and stumbles into the hotcell.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Alpharael emerges holding the stone, which glistens and begins to lift him upward.
timeline.quote: Alpharael emerges. He's holding the weird stone in his hand.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: The subedar orders her troops to kill Sami's group.
timeline.quote: Enough. Kill them.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Alpharael floats in panic, crying out to Raphaella, Zagachoir and Slats and begging not to be sent back.
timeline.quote: I can't go back. I want to live! Don't send me back!

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: The Kav groan in anguish as their bodies twist inside their armor.
timeline.quote: The subedar groans. All the Kav groan.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Alpharael's voice changes and he speaks a prayer to INEVITA.
timeline.quote: INEVITA! Begin in me thy ending!

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: A voice speaking through Alpharael says it is not a god and has limits.
timeline.quote: I am not a god, though I was fashioned for the use of one. I have limits.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: The voice says it needs a wielder who offers a library of moments to alter.
timeline.quote: I need a wielder who offers me a library of moments to alter.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami broadcasts a mayday to Taro-duend reporting twenty-four Kav soldiers with lethal radiation trauma.
timeline.quote: Twenty-four KMN aboard with lethal radiation trauma.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 6" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: It is explained that Alpharael's Hopelight irradiated the Kav Memorial team when it crashed.
timeline.quote: When Alpharael's Hopelight came down, it irradiated the entire Kav Memorial team with its fusion engine.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 6" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: The dying Kav staggered into the Seriema's cargo bay and begged for rescue.
timeline.quote: They had just enough strength left to stagger into the Seriema 's cargo bay and beg for rescue.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 6" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami denies to Taro-duend that the Seriema fired a fusion drive.
timeline.quote: It wasn't us.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 6" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Vondam orders the Sundog to repeat its demand that Taro-duend hand over the spy and to launch Hopelights for surveillance.
timeline.quote: Give them another chance to hand over the spy. Launch the Hopelights.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Tannuk finds a stratosat balloon and uses the subedar's codes to request the Guns' radar.
timeline.quote: Forty kilometers above the southern horizon is an armored stratosat balloon.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The Sundog lasers the stratosat after realizing what Tannuk is doing.
timeline.quote: A laser flicks out and kills the stratosat.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The Guns of Kavaron fire on the pursuing Hopelight.
timeline.quote: The Guns of Kavaron fire.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The Hopelight Flare Three is hit by the Guns, loses its tail and ejects its crew.
timeline.quote: The Hopelight, callsign Flare Three , flashes up white.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The Sundog jams the radar, so the Guns miss their second shot.
timeline.quote: The Guns stab down again. But this time, they miss.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The Seriema lunges up into space.
timeline.quote: The Seriema lunges up into space.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The Kavaron Memorial Navy swarms Kavaron That Is searching for the authors of the atrocity.
timeline.quote: But by now, every ship in the Kavaron Memorial Navy is swarming out over Kavaron That Is, looking for the authors of the atrocity captured on the Seriema 's cameras.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Mantis learns that six thousand died on Kavaron.
timeline.quote: Six thousand dead on Kavaron.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: After bad luck including Mirri's disappearance, Sami lost most of their crew to more lucrative outfits.
timeline.quote: After a run of bad luck (including the disappearance of their beloved cat, Mirri), they lost most of their crew to more lucrative outfits.

citation.work: The Legends of Edge of Eternities
citation.text: "The Legends of Edge of Eternities" by Miguel Lopez, Amanda LaFranco, Laurel Pratt, Jay Annelli. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Tannuk was dishonorably discharged from the KMN for redirecting a falling chunk of the debris belt.
timeline.quote: He was dishonorably discharged after redirecting a falling chunk of the Kavaron debris belt to minimize collateral damage, a crime among the disaster-prone remnants of the Kav homeworld.

citation.work: The Legends of Edge of Eternities
citation.text: "The Legends of Edge of Eternities" by Miguel Lopez, Amanda LaFranco, Laurel Pratt, Jay Annelli. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Thendar is fired and deposited back on Kavaron That Is for skimming ore.
timeline.quote: Swiftly fired from his position and deposited back on Kavaron That Is

citation.work: The Legends of Edge of Eternities
citation.text: "The Legends of Edge of Eternities" by Miguel Lopez, Amanda LaFranco, Laurel Pratt, Jay Annelli. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The shattered half of the planet is named Kavaron That Is and the capital moves to Kavaron Before.
timeline.quote: "Thus, the shattered half of the planet was named Kavaron That Is, and the capital was moved to Kavaron Before."

citation.text: Command Tower (Edge of Eternities Commander, 2025), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Kav learned the lesson about mining too deep, but Zern Miffles did not.
timeline.quote: The Kav had learned their lesson about mining too deep. Zern Miffles had not.

citation.text: Beamsaw Prospector (Edge of Eternities, 2025), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Kav's mining appetite ended their world.
timeline.quote: The rapacious appetite that ended their world became the only means by which the Kav could lift their civilization from it.

citation.text: Drill Too Deep (Edge of Eternities, 2025), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Those in power on Kavaron ignored the planet's warnings until Exodus Day.
timeline.quote: Even until Exodus Day, those in power on Kavaron refused to acknowledge that the planet was trying to tell them something.

citation.text: Remnant Elemental (Edge of Eternities, 2025), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Falling shards of Kavaron shattered Evendo's icy shell, awakening dormant life.
timeline.quote: When falling shards of Kavaron shattered the icy shell of Evendo, the Eumidian seed pods were far from the only form of life awakened from slumber.

citation.text: Fungal Colossus (Edge of Eternities, 2025), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Kavaron's degradation poisoned hearts, which the Monoists exploited.
timeline.quote: Kavaron's degradation poisoned many hearts, which the Monoists were happy to exploit.

citation.text: Mutinous Massacre (Edge of Eternities, 2025), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Kav's industrial strip mining for moxite shatters Kavaron into two halves.
timeline.quote: A terrestrial planet that was shattered by the Kav's industrial strip mining for moxite, splitting it into two halves.

citation.text: "Edge", section "Astrography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eumidians on Evendo leave hibernation because meteors from crumbling Kavaron heat the planet.
timeline.quote: Left hibernation recently due to the heating of Evendo from meteors originating from the crumbling planet Kavaron.

citation.text: "Edge", section "Factions". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Endstone manipulates a fight between the Sunstar Free Company and Kavaron's defenders to help Sami, Tannuk and Alpharael escape.
timeline.quote: The Endstone manipulated a fight between the Sunstar Free Company and the defenders of Kavaron to help Sami, Tannuk, and Alpharael escape.

citation.text: "Endstone", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Haliya finds Alpharael and tries to force him to alter the past with the Endstone; when nothing happens she tries to have everyone obliterated.
timeline.quote: When nothing happened, she tried to have them all obliterated by the Sunstar Company.

citation.text: "Endstone", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vondam orders Kavaron's civilians killed instead of Haliya and the others, leading her to believe the Endstone cannot fall into the Summists' hands.
timeline.quote: Vondam ordered the innocent civilians of Kavaron to be killed instead of Haliya and the others on the ship

citation.text: "Endstone", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sami buys the Seriema.
timeline.quote: Sami later bought a ship of their own, called the Seriema .

citation.text: "Sami", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sami and Tannuk save Alpharael after his ship crashes; Summists pursue, Haliya tries to steal the stone, and Sami and Tannuk flee Kavaron.
timeline.quote: allowing Sami and Tannuk to access the ship's controls and flee Kavaron

citation.text: "Sami", section "Hunt for the Endstone". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Driven by the coming supernova, the Kav's mining collapses Kavaron, which crumbles into space during the Ruin.
timeline.quote: The planet finally crumbled after centuries of Kav industrial strip mining

citation.text: "Kavaron", section "The Ruin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On Exodus Day the first Kav shuttle lifts the first refugees off Kavaron.
timeline.quote: the first Kav shuttle lifted the first flight of refugees off Kavaron's unstable surface

citation.text: "Kavaron", section "The Ruin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A Ring strike decelerated by Tannuk hits a Rushdown village, killing most of its inhabitants.
timeline.quote: killing 25,000 of its 30,000 inhabitants

citation.text: "Kavaron", section "Geography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Kav accelerate destructive mining to lift their species and biome off-world as cataclysms tear Kavaron apart.
timeline.quote: the Kav accelerated their extensive yet destabilizing mining projects

citation.text: "Kavaronic Federal Empire", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On Exodus Day the first Kav shuttle lifts the first refugees off Kavaron.
timeline.quote: the first Kav shuttle lifted the first flight of refugees off Kavaron's unstable surface

citation.text: "Kavaronic Federal Empire", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: They rescue Alpharael, who is pursued by the Sunstar Free Company.
timeline.quote: rescuing him after his Hopelight warmaker crashed in the debris field

citation.text: "Mission for the Endstone", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: While evading Sunstar Free Company forces on Kavaron, the Seriema's radar is smashed and its main drive nozzle lasered off.
timeline.quote: her radar was smashed and the magnet nozzle for her main drive was lasered off

citation.text: "Seriema", section "Condition". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tannuk commanded the Guns of Kavaron to fire on a bolide, sparing Summotank but killing twenty-five thousand elsewhere; he was banished from the planet.
timeline.quote: he was banished from the planet

citation.text: "Tannuk", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: They rescued Alpharael after his warmaker crashed.
timeline.quote: They managed to save the Monoist

citation.text: "Tannuk", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Taro-duend sits on Kavaron That Is.
relations.quote: Taro-duend is a burst of color on the basalt and glass of Kavaron That Is.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 6" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jun 2025.

relations.quote: It is the homeworld of the Kav

citation.text: "Kavaron". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: The remaining whole side of the planet.
relations.quote: The Kav regard Kavaron as split into two hemispheres

citation.text: "Kavaron", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Kavaronic Federal Empire", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: They are native to the planet Kavaron

citation.text: "Kavu", section "The Edge". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: The Kav homeworld, torn in two by the Kav's delving and ringed by the Mordraine Ring, Duranuw.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 1" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2025.

pages_say.description: The crumbling Kav homeworld, split into a stabilized half, Kavaron Before, and a churning ruin, Kavaron That Is.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Edge of Eternities
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Edge of Eternities" by Miguel Lopez, Jay Annelli, Laurel Pratt, Amanda LaFranco. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2025.

pages_say.description: The ruined, crumbling half of the Kav homeworld that the KMN tracks.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | Grasp in the Dark
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Grasp in the Dark" by RJ Taylor. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Jun 2025.

pages_say.description: Tannuk's forbidden homeworld and the next stop on their flight plan.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 2" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jun 2025.

pages_say.description: Sothera's richest world, torn in two by the Ruin: Kavaron Before, the habitable half, and Kavaron That Is, the broken half where debris falls and the Kav memorial teams patrol.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

pages_say.description: A broken planet, with Kavaron That Is the ruined half where Taro-duend stands and Kavaron Before the habitable half.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 6" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jun 2025.

pages_say.description: The ruined Kav world where the story takes place.
